page.overview:
What is Magnetic grappling gun?

A magnetic grappling gun was a gun loaded with a grappling line that could magnetically latch onto its target. while infiltrating the Governor's mansion on the Mid Rim planet Haidoral Prime, a Rebel Alliance squad led by First Sergeant Hazram Namir used a magnetic grappling gun to reach one of the mansion's balconies from a nearby rooftop garden. Pol Andrissus set up the gun in one of the flower beds.

A magnetic grappling gun appeared in the 2015 novel Battlefront: Twilight Company, written by Alexander Freed.
